preconditions.description: S1 and S2 must have equal length.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S1) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S2)
preconditions.description: S1 and S2 consist only of lowercase English letters.
The length of S1 and S2 is at most 31.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (len(S1) == 0 and len(S2) == 0) or (len(S1) == 1 and S1 == S2) or any((len(S1) > 0) and (any((S1[:i] == S2[:i] and S1[i:] == S2[i:]) or (S1[:i] == S2[-i:] and S1[i:] == S2[:-i])) for i in range(1, len(S1))) and isScramble(S1[:i], S2[:i]) and isScramble(S1[i:], S2[i:]) or isScramble(S1[:i], S2[-i:]) and isScramble(S1[i:], S2[:-i]))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if S2 is a scrambled form of S1, meaning S2 can be obtained by recursively partitioning S1 into two non-empty substrings and swapping their children in any non-leaf node of the binary tree representation.
